context: Mom and daughter, an everyday slip-up at home.
purpose: Casual home register hitting common stragglers (しまい/彼女/無い/使わ/八) naturally.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お母さん、牛乳を使い切ってしまい。
lines.en: Mom, I used up all the milk.
lines.style: sheepish adult daughter voice, soft warm rueful honest throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm mild surprise affectionate throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、全部使わせてもらっちゃった。
lines.en: Yeah, I used all of it.
lines.style: apologetic adult daughter voice, soft warm honest throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 八時までに、買ってきてくれる?
lines.en: Could you buy some by eight o'clock?
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm gently asking throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、友達の彼女も誘って行くね。
lines.en: Yeah, I'll invite my friend's girlfriend and go.
lines.style: cheerful adult daughter voice, soft warm relaxed throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: その彼女に、よろしく伝えてね。
lines.en: Say hello to that girlfriend for me.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm affectionate throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 卵も無いから、ついでに買うね。
lines.en: There are no eggs either, so I'll grab some too.
lines.style: helpful adult daughter voice, soft warm relaxed throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 助かるわ。八時には戻ってね。
lines.en: That helps. Be back by eight.
lines.style: grateful mother voice, soft warm caring closing throughout
